info.title: CinemaGo reservations service
info.description:
Reservations service of CinemaGo. Users book seats for a screening, change or remove seats while the reservation is pending, and cancel it.

## How to call it

- **Through the Traefik gateway** (server `/api`, for example `http://localhost:8080/api/reservations`): log in with `POST /api/users/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (use the Authorize button). Traefik checks the token with the users service and passes `X-User-Id` and `X-User-Role` on to this service. Headers with those names sent by the client are replaced by Traefik.
- **Directly** (server `/`, dev port 8084): there is no token check, set `X-User-Id` and `X-User-Role` yourself.

Without a logged in user the service answers 401. Users can only see and change their own reservations (403 otherwise), admins can see and change all of them.

Public without a token: `GET /health`, `GET /reservations/screenings/{screeningId}/seats`, `/docs` and `/openapi.json`.

## Reservation status

`pending` after booking, `paid` after payment (payments service, later), `cancelled` after cancel. Seats can only be changed while the reservation is `pending`.

## Seats

A seat is a row and a seat number, both 1 to 50. One reservation has 1 to 10 seats. A seat can only be taken once per screening, cancelled reservations and removed seats free their seats again.

## Errors

Every error from this service is JSON like `{"error": "reservation not found"}`. This includes bad JSON bodies (400, 415, 422), bad path or query values (400) and unknown paths (404). When the service is down, the gateway itself answers 502 or 503 without a JSON body.

servers.description: Direct to the reservations service (dev port 8084), set X-User-Id and X-User-Role yourself
Through the Traefik gateway (port 8080), use a bearer token

get.description: Returns `{"status":"ok"}` when the service is running. No token needed. Docker and Traefik use it to know when the service is ready.

Returns one page of reservations with their seats, sorted by id.

**Who can call it:** any logged in user.

- A normal user only sees their own reservations. `userId` can be left out or set to their own id, any other id returns 403.
- An admin sees the reservations of all users, or of one user with `?userId=`.

Cancelled and paid reservations are included, check `status`.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Id of the logged in user. Set by Traefik from the token, only send it yourself when calling the service directly.

parameters.name: X-User-Role
parameters.description: Role of the logged in user, `user` or `admin`. Set by Traefik like X-User-Id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starts at 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Reservations per page, 1 to 100. Default 20.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Only reservations of this user. Admins can use any id, a normal user only their own id (other ids give 403).

400.description: `page` or `pageSize` is out of range or not a number.

value.error: Failed to deserialize query string: page: invalid digit found in string

Out of range.summary: page below 1 or pageSize not 1 to 100

value.error: page must be at least 1 and pageSize 1 to 100

401.description: No logged in user: the X-User-Id or X-User-Role header is missing or invalid. Through the gateway this means the bearer token is missing, expired or invalid (that 401 comes from the users service).

403.description: A normal user asked for the reservations of another user with `userId`.

500.description: Unexpected database error. The details are only in the service log.

post.description:
Creates a reservation for the logged in user with status `pending`.

**Who can call it:** any logged in user. The reservation always belongs to the caller.

**Rules:**
- 1 to 10 seats, row and number 1 to 50, the same seat only once in the list.
- The service asks the screenings service (`GET /screenings/{id}`) if the screening exists. If screenings answers 404, the booking fails with 404. If screenings is not reachable, the check is skipped and the booking still works.
- All seats are saved together. If one seat is already taken by a pending or paid reservation, nothing is saved and the answer is 409.

get.description:
Lists the seats of one screening that are already booked (pending or paid reservations). The frontend uses it to draw the seat map. Seats of cancelled reservations and removed seats are free again and not listed.

**Who can call it:** everyone, no token needed. Through the gateway it is the only public reservations path besides health and docs.

The screening is not checked here, an unknown screening simply has no taken seats.

put.summary: Change the seats of a reservation
put.description:
Replaces all seats of a reservation with the seats in the body. The screening stays the same.

**Who can call it:** the user who made the reservation, or an admin.

**Rules:**
- Only `pending` reservations can be changed, paid or cancelled ones return 409.
- Same seat rules as booking: 1 to 10 seats, row and number 1 to 50, no seat twice.
- Old seats are freed and new seats are taken in one step. Keeping some of the old seats in the list is fine. If a new seat is taken by someone else, nothing changes and the answer is 409.
- Seats get new ids.

delete.description:
Sets the status to `cancelled` and frees all its seats, so others can book them. The reservation itself is kept and still shows up in the list with its old seats.

**Who can call it:** the user who made the reservation, or an admin.

Pending and paid reservations can be cancelled (refunds for paid ones come with the payments service). Cancelling twice returns 409.

delete.summary: Remove one seat from a reservation
delete.description:
Deletes one seat from a reservation, the seat is free again right away. The seat id is the `id` in the `seats` list of the reservation.

**Who can call it:** the user who made the reservation, or an admin.

**Rules:**
- Only `pending` reservations can be changed.
- The last seat cannot be removed, cancel the reservation instead.
